facts.fact: Decide whether to renew with Nordfrakt or switch freight supplier.
The logistics steering group: five people, not finance specialists.
The memo is needed before the steering group meeting on {{today+14d}}.
One page at most, in English.
A clear recommendation, with the yearly cost difference in SEK for each alternative.
Only Baltic Cargo and Skanlog are realistic alternatives.
